title: Arrow Path: only bring back saved arrows on real squares
body:
When a board puzzle resumes, `restoreArrows` brings back the arrows she had placed, and drops any that don't make sense. It still let through odd keys like `"1.5,2"` or `"01,2"`, which aren't real squares. They were never drawn or walked on, but they stayed in the save.

## What changed
- `games/arrow-path/view.js`: a saved arrow is only kept if its key is exactly a whole-number square, written the way the game writes it (`"row,col"`).
- `tests/unit/games/arrow-path.test.js`: the existing resume test now also checks keys like `"1.5,2"`, `"01,2"`, `" 1,2"` and `"1,2,0"` are dropped, while a normal one is kept.

## How to try it
`node tests/serve.mjs`, open `http://localhost:4173/logic-lane/`, Arrow Path → Easy, put an arrow down and reload: it's still there.

## Checks
- The new checks are inside an existing test, so the test count doesn't change.
- Local `npm run check`: type check passed, 378 unit tests passed, 183 browser tests passed. Visual snapshots skipped locally (they run only on GitHub); no picture should change.
- No decisions changed. No packages added or upgraded.
